blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `updateInventoryItems` method. This belongs to the Inventory Next Module.
You should only use this methods when implementing complex customizations. For common cases, check out [available workflows instead](/medusa-workflows-reference).
This method updates an existing inventory item.
